newsitem.title: USA: Axent names John Becker President/COO.
newsitem.headline: Axent names John Becker President/COO.

text.p: AXENT Technologies Inc said on Thursday that it named John Becker as president and chief operating officer.
The company also named Robert Edwards Jr as chief financial officer.
Edwards replaces Becker who served as chief financial officer, vice president and treasurer.
Edwards recently served as vice president of finance of the company.

"John (Becker) was a key player in the successful public launch of AXENT Technologies last spring, and also played a major role in the management of our company's operations," said chairman and chief executive officer, Richard Lefebvre, in a statement.
AXENT Technologies provides information security solutions for client/server computing environments.
